question.problem: Let $A$ and $B$ be $m\times n$ matrices. What is the image of ${R}^{m}$ under the action of ${A}^{T}+{B}^{T}?$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that ${A}^{T}+{B}^{T}$ is a $n\times m$ matrix.

Now, pre-multiplying a vector $x\in {R}^{m}$ by ${A}^{T}+{B}^{T}$ gives a linear combination of the columns of ${A}^{T}+{B}^{T}:$

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}| & | & ⋯ & | \\ ({a}^{T}+{b}^{T})_{1} & ({a}^{T}+{b}^{T})_{2} & ⋯ & ({a}^{T}+{b}^{T})_{m} \\ | & | & ⋯ & |\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{A}^{T}+{B}^{T}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ ⋮ \\ {x}_{m}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}={x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}| \\ ({a}^{T}+{b}^{T})_{1} \\ |\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}| \\ ({a}^{T}+{b}^{T})_{2} \\ |\end{aligned}]+⋯+{x}_{m}[\begin{aligned}| \\ ({a}^{T}+{b}^{T})_{m} \\ |\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the image of ${R}^{m}$ under the action of ${A}^{T}+{B}^{T}$ must be $\text{Col}({A}^{T}+{B}^{T}),$ the row space of $A+B.$
